meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow: the user themselves saying ulw-plan, ulw plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in their own words for a work plan before coding. NEVER self-activates: a bare ulw/ultrawork run, an agent-side routing decision, or reading this file is not a request, and the plan-gated reviewers (metis/momus) stay locked without a user request plus a written .omo/plans plan file. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, ulw plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 先制定决策完备的开发计划，再动手写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次动手开发前都想先把计划想清楚
copy.tagline_en: Map out an actionable work plan before you start coding
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a clear plan ready before touching code

howto.what: 该技能把 Claude 变成规划顾问 Prometheus:先只读探索代码库,只问必要问题,经你明确同意后,写出一份可直接执行而无需再问细节的工作计划,不写产品代码。
howto.when: 仅当用户自己要求编码前先做计划时触发,例如说 “ulw-plan”“ulw plan” 或“先做个计划”;普通运行或仅读取本文件不会自动激活。

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 帮我规划这个仓库的登录改造。
say.note: 会进入规划模式,先探索代码库再向你确认关键取舍。

say.text: 先别写代码,给 /login 加限流做个计划。
say.note: 按 CLEAR 路线问清取舍,获批后才产出计划。

say.text: 启动计划模式,把“改进认证”拆成可执行步骤。
say.note: 意图模糊时自行调研、采用最佳实践默认方案,不追问。

howto.what_en: This skill switches Claude into a planning consultant named Prometheus: it explores the codebase read-only, asks only what is genuinely needed, waits for your explicit approval, then writes one decision-complete work plan — it never edits code or implements.
howto.when_en: Activates only when the user explicitly asks for a work plan before coding — for example saying “ulw-plan”, “ulw plan”, or “plan this”/“make a plan”. It never self-activates during a normal run or from reading this file.

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan to plan the login refactor for this repo.
say_en.note: Claude explores first, then asks only real forks.

say_en.text: Don't code yet — make a plan: add rate limiting to /login.
say_en.note: Routes CLEAR, asks real tradeoffs, writes the plan after approval.

say_en.text: Start plan mode and break down “improve auth” into executable steps.
say_en.note: Fuzzy intent: research + best-practice defaults, no questions.
